gloss: opening of the doors (of a venue)

definitions.gloss: opening of the doors; admission begins
definitions.explanation: The point at which a hall, theater or stadium opens its doors and lets the audience in, usually some time before the performance or event starts ({開演|かいえん}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧{開場|かいじょう}です。
{開場|かいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A long line had formed even before the doors opened.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開場|かいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧30{分|ぷん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いて→着く：00680_tsuku⟧おこう。
examples.english: The concert starts thirty minutes after the doors open, so let's get there early.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開場|かいじょう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: doors-open time
- {開場|かいじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: (a venue) opens its doors
- {開場|かいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait for the doors to open

WATCH OUT:
Tickets and posters list two times: {開場|かいじょう} (doors open) and ⟦{開演|かいえん}→開演：23500_kaien⟧ (the performance starts). Do not confuse {開場|かいじょう} with its homophones ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧ (venue) and ⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧ (at sea). The opposite is {閉場|へいじょう}, when the venue closes.
